text:
jordan: FYI Helios just asked to expand the scope of the POC: they want streaming responses + BYO-KMS for key management and logs. Theyxpect no timeline or price changes. :grimacing:
amy: Do we know the use case for streaming? Is this a live chat UI or a backend fan-out?
devon: It's live chat. They said short-turn replies and are targeting ~100-200ms p95. They also insisted on BYO-KMS because of PII rules. They're pushing for the original 3-week window.
sara: Streaming + BYO-KMS increases infra and security work. Streaming needs websocket/fronting and may reduce batching efficiency. BYO-KMS usually implies Dedicated or Private deployment to meet key isolation requirements.
jordan: Felipe is pushing hard for zero-cost changes. We should scope options and recommended path with tradeoffs.
amy: Option set from quick triage: 1) Hosted demo with streamed UI via edge websocket + host-managed keys and redaction — fastest but fails BYO-KMS requirement. 2) Short Dedicated trial with KMS integration — satisfies BYO-KMS but longer onboarding and cost. 3) Hybrid: hosted live demo (no BYO-KMS) + offline replay to validate KMS handshake and encryption of logs.
chris: For acceptance criteria split infra vs quality: - Latency: p95  250ms for 95% of sessions; - Concurrency: support 50 active concurrent users; - Quality: >= 87% PASS on their prompt eval set; - Security: KMS provisioning and handshake validated in staging env.
devon: Financially: streaming changes usage patterns (higher tokens, lower batching gains). Dedicated trial will need a setup fee + an estimated 20% uplift for KMS integration maintenance. I'll get exact numbers from finance but flagging now. :money_with_wings:
jordan: If they accept the hybrid/demo approach, can we still hit 3 weeks?
sara: Yes for a functional demo. Make it explicit: the live demo won't use BYO-KMS; the KMS flow will be validated offline with a replay of events. Full BYO-KMS + streaming in production needs Dedicated/Private and ~4-6 weeks to configure and test.
amy: Also recommend tightening the eval suite for streaming-specific issues: propose 50 short-turn convo prompts and 20 longer-context prompts to catch partial/streaming truncation or tokenization regressions. Example small snippet for the eval harness:
```
# short-turn sample
User: "When will my order ship?"
System: <should_reply_with_eta>
```
Use both exact-match checks and semantic similarity thresholds.
chris: Add rollout & monitoring to the SOW: canary at 10%, monitor p95 and error-rate; rollback trigger if error-rate > 1% sustained over 30 minutes or quality drops > 5pt.
devon: Expect pushback on costs. Proposed commercial addendum: discount trial but require coverage for Dedicated setup costs if BYO-KMS is needed. I'll draft pricing lines.
jordan: Need someone to draft a scoping note and SOW bullets I can send Felipe. Include timeline options, clear pass/fail criteria, estimated cost delta, and the minimal demo approach.
amy: I'll draft the scoping bullets, the eval checklist, and an explicit list of assumptions (no BYO-KMS on live demo, replay will validate keys). Will share today. :thumbsup:
sara: I'll produce the infra/RBAC/KMS gating checklist and required customer deliverables (network peering, certificates, key material handoff).
chris: I'll draft the monitoring playbook: dashboards, alerts, and rollback steps.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: review-draft in 24h for 1840501122.
jordan: Thanks — target: email + SOW bullets ready by Monday EOD. :eyes:
